negative_recovery_convention.meaning: adaptation did not merely fail to close the gap, it widened the raw transfer gap

ratio_guard.action: replicate excluded from the ratio CI and counted

uncertainty.note: within, raw and adapted are all resampled on the SAME target spatial-block replicate, so the fraction CIs carry full joint uncertainty across all three terms.

preregistration.supersedes: the earlier two-region 27-31% recovered / 69-73% remaining figures, which must not be carried forward
